findings.text: Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q8). After this commit no other module imports the exported isDirectory, and it is still the fail-open form the new CLAUDE.md rule retires. Make it module-private, or replace its remaining callers (722, 819, 841, 991) with kindAt.

Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q6/Q11). headOf decides 'is a repository here' through isDirectory, and headOfGitDir reads an unreadable HEAD as 'no commit'. So a listable .git whose HEAD cannot be read, with its manifest deleted, gets a new knowledge.json. The CLAUDE.md sentence that 'the disk is asked with lookAt, kindAt and namesIn' also claims more than refuseForeign's existsOnDisk/mustBe, reachedByFolders, readIntent and adopt do. Reaching it takes two manual changes, and git fails right after, so this is advisory. Narrow the sentence or route headOf through lookAt.

Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q2). The project branch (257-264) repeats the fixed-scope guard at 216-221, and the early return at 249-254 repeats 271. It is four lines of logic, advisory as round seven ruled the copied unseen rule. One helper would keep the rule in one place.

Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q2, carried from round seven's F-13). projectFolders is still a copy of resolve.ts:116-127. It now uses the same namesIn/kindAt, so the two behave alike. With no database, knowledge/projects is listed twice (667 and 728).
Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q2, carried). The .git walk keeps its own ENOENT-only catch and its own message, where unseen(folder, error) would do.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q3, carried). The hint is now limited to EACCES/EPERM, but the name unseen still describes neither what the function returns nor its rule.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q3, carried). refuseLinkedRoots, and likewise refuseLinksInside (245), now also refuse what cannot be looked at, but the names still say only 'linked'.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q6, carried). rebuild prints only after rebuildAll returns, so a kindAt refusal in the removal loop (index-store.ts:595) drops results that were already computed.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q5/Q8, carried). readIntent only forwards to readRecord, and only tests import it.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q5, carried). Only tests use keepBytes' default name and its return value.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q2, carried). adopt repeats underLeases' lease nesting.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q4/Q5, carried). Three knobs are set only by tests: GitOptions.timeoutMs, resolveRepo's folderName and DoctorContext.gitVersion.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q8, carried). moduleVersion and readEntry are exports that only tests import.
Outside the change: debt. isDirectory reads every error as false and feeds readGitInfo, which the diff does not touch.
Outside the change: debt, carried. 'db as Db' casts a database that may be null. The repeat at checks.ts:622 is the same pattern, advisory.

Upheld as a defect (Q1/Q7, AC-2). The clause '&& headOf(path) === null', added in this diff, keeps the engine from writing a new knowledge.json into a repository that has commits. No test holds it. probes/round-eight-two-mutants.md dropped the clause and ran knowledge-resolve.test.ts and knowledge-index.test.ts: the mutant SURVIVED. One reasonable assertion kills it: expect(existsSync(manifest)).toBe(false) after the create at knowledge-index.test.ts:598.

Upheld as a defect (Q1/Q7, AC-10 and ADR 0024's 'doctor lists the folders by the same rules, with and without a database'). foldersByHand's 'kindAt(path) !== "absent"' is a line of this diff, and no test puts a link or a file at knowledge/workspace or knowledge/shared. probes/round-eight-two-mutants.md restored the folder-only test and ran doctor-knowledge.test.ts: the mutant SURVIVED. This is the with/without-database disagreement round seven upheld, here for the fixed scopes. One more case in the link test (doctor-knowledge.test.ts:318), at the workspace's name with storeDir elsewhere, kills it.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q1). The !create return and ensureParents after refuseForeign cover a race between the listing and the look. No test drives that race. It is defence in depth.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q6). No test shows the hint left out for a code other than EACCES/EPERM. That is error handling the criteria do not cover, and the EACCES side is held.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q1). At 0o600 only the rebuild path holds a refresh, since fingerprintOf swallows by documented design (repo.ts:847-851).
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). No case on any platform holds the '[\\:]' clause at src/core/git.ts:69.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). The fixture leaves no intent record, so moving refuseForeign after revertInterrupted survives.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). No test holds that adopt and list print as each repository finishes.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). No test holds underOwnLease's 'started ||' rule.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). Nothing tests what the commands print for a listed folder with no repository. probes/project-folder-with-no-repository.md shows the output by hand.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). Swapping record-first and kept bytes in adoptIn leaves the suite green.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). No test adds a file during a write's git calls. This is a stated known limit.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q5, carried). The rebuild-order test depends on the internal renewal count, and it still fails on reversion.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (AC-8, carried). Only the version probe times out, and the test does not check that the process is gone.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (AC-2, carried). The parent's .gitignore weakens the empty-status proof.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (AC-13, carried). Clipping is checked on the thrown message, not on the log line.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (AC-2, carried). The test resolves through the row, not through the manifest.

Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). The .git walk skips the folders inside objects/, and configArgs sets neither gc.auto=0 nor maintenance.auto=false. Reasoned, not run, and outside the named risk areas.

Upheld as advisory, as filed. doctor now puts a listed name into its warning for a link or a file at that name too, and the name can carry terminal escapes. This is output hardening outside the named risk areas.

Upheld as advisory, as filed. refuseForeign's mustBe and existsOnDisk (214) read any lstat failure as 'nothing there', against the commit's own rule. The reviewer traced every caller and each fails closed afterwards. This is hardening only.

Upheld as advisory, as filed. There is a time-of-check gap between refuseForeign and git init when a listed name vanishes. Exploiting it needs write access to the mode-0700 data directory at that moment.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). taxonomyFor has no guard of its own.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). A leftover lock reads as a git fault, and the intent record is read with no size cap. Both affect availability only.

Upheld as advisory, as filed. A project folder still present with no repository keeps its old rows through rebuild. probes/project-folder-with-no-repository.md confirms that the rows stay and that rebuild exits 0. It refutes 'prints nothing': rebuild prints '<folder>: not a repository' and doctor warns. No reader of the index exists yet.
Upheld as advisory, as filed. A stray non-dot file in knowledge/projects/ (Icon\r, desktop.ini) is now a permanent doctor warning and a rebuild orphan. It is noise, and it blocks nothing.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). kindAt can throw in the deletion loop after the rebuilds when a name becomes unlookable mid-run. A rerun completes it.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried, partly addressed). The refusal is still code invalid, with no log line and exit 1.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). gc.auto=0 is not set. A collision is undone, and a retry works.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). A locked lease or a timeout in one repository stops the ones after it.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). adopt's 'was undone' overstates for paths that were only unstaged, and for kept bytes that are not written back.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). The 'not one this version writes' message also covers a corrupt record.

Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). The Risks and rollback section predates ADR 0024:87-93's refusal-by-name rules. Rollback is stated at spec.md:321, so this is not a missing rollback, and ADR 0024 declares itself the later text.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried, stated in Known limits). The module migration pass is not contained, and leftovers are not removed.
Outside the change: debt. bun run lint processes 0 files in this worktree. The session ran biome by folder name (346 files, no errors).
Outside the change: debt that predates the item. The p95 test is flaky under load.
Outside the change: debt that predates the item. The upgrade runner waits up to 10 s under BEGIN IMMEDIATE.

Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q5/Q6). The universal 'asked with lookAt, kindAt and namesIn' sentence, and ADR 0024:88's lead-in, claim more than the code does. isDirectory/existsOnDisk still decide presence at repo.ts:203, 214, 732, 841, 1177 and store.ts:792, each behind an earlier refusal. No boundary is crossed. Narrow the wording or retire the two helpers. The code-quality gate makes the same point at resolve.ts:268.

Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q6). The fixed scopes rewrite a missing manifest even in a repository that has commits, while projects (268) do not. ADR 0024:69 records only the project rule. Apply the same headOf guard, or say in the ADR why the two differ.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). The function-level import cycles repo.ts<->resolve.ts and repo.ts<->author.ts remain, with no new edge.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). The spec's Design lacks the row-first rule. ADR 0024 is the later text and records it at :69 and :88-93.
Outside the change: debt, carried. readGitInfo follows any ref: in HEAD.
Outside the change: debt, carried. SettingKey omits WIZARDINGCODE_MODULES and WIZARDINGCODE_MEM_AUTHOR.
Outside the change: debt, carried. No forward reference to ADR 0024.
Outside the change: debt, carried. ADR 0010 still uses the retired SHIBAOX_* names, and ADR 0024:87 now points readers there.

Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q1). rebuild under a data directory with no knowledge/ folder deletes every knowledge row. probes/rebuild-under-another-data-directory.md confirms it: back under the right directory, a path-only project's folder is reported as an orphan and the project has no repository, while the files are untouched. The reviewer filed it as advisory (a manual command, files intact, the predicate narrowed this round), and the judge does not raise a filed severity. The concrete fix is to refuse the removal loop when the knowledge root itself is absent and rows exist. Worth taking with the two test-quality defects.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). A HEAD naming a ref with .., \ or : reads as 'no commit'. The rows stay as last indexed.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). The DELETE FROM meta cannot be undone. Its reason is stated at :17-18, and it runs after the pre-upgrade backup.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). settle takes the fingerprint after the commit. This is a known limit stated in ADR 0024.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried, Q6). The one-time VACUUM INTO backup under the write lock has not been timed on a store that ran the withdrawn module.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried, Q2). project_aliases is read by project_id with no index. It is off the hook path, and the table is small.
Outside the change: debt. project_aliases has no index on project_id.
